name: Sheep
overview: Scripture reveals sheep as central to God's covenantal relationship with His people, symbolizing provision, sacrifice, and stewardship. From Abel's offering of the firstlings of his flock, which found favor with the Lord, to Noah's burnt offerings after the flood, and Abraham's substitutionary ram, sheep are presented as both a tangible blessing and a foreshadowing of atoning sacrifice. The detailed instructions for offerings involving sheep in the Mosaic Law further emphasize their sacred role in worship and obedience.
